plain_text:
A s we get older, our bodies change in
ways that can affect our health and
well-being. Over time, our cells age and
change and our organs may not function as well.
This increases our risk for chronic diseases and
other health problems.
semantic_text: A s we get older, our bodies change in ways that can affect our health and well-being. Over time, our cells age and change and our organs may not function as well. This increases our risk for chronic diseases and other health problems.

plain_text:
Ever wondered why some people seem younger or older
than their actual age? It's because age is more than just a
number! Although aging is a natural process that happens
to all of us, it doesn't affect every body in the same ways.
semantic_text: Ever wondered why some people seem younger or older than their actual age? It's because age is more than just a number! Although aging is a natural process that happens to all of us, it doesn't affect every body in the same ways.

plain_text:
Some animals seem to have a slower aging process and
tend to live longer lives. Cold-blooded animals such as
reptiles and amphibians have some of the longest lifespans
for their size. Take turtles, for example—some species of
this reptile can live for over 150 years!
semantic_text: Some animals seem to have a slower aging process and tend to live longer lives. Cold-blooded animals such as reptiles and amphibians have some of the longest lifespans for their size. Take turtles, for example—some species of this reptile can live for over 150 years!

plain_text:
What can we learn from these long-lived creatures? In a recent
large study, funded in part by the National Institute on Aging, an
international team set out to answer that very question.
semantic_text: What can we learn from these long-lived creatures? In a recent large study, funded in part by the National Institute on Aging, an international team set out to answer that very question.

plain_text:
Chronological age: The number of years you've
been alive.
semantic_text: Chronological age: The number of years you've been alive.

plain_text:
Biological age: How old your cells, tissues, and
organs appear to be based on your body's overall
health and functioning. This can be different from
your actual age. It accounts for factors like your
genetics and lifestyle and how your body is affected
by the aging process.
semantic_text: Biological age: How old your cells, tissues, and organs appear to be based on your body's overall health and functioning. This can be different from your actual age. It accounts for factors like your genetics and lifestyle and how your body is affected by the aging process.

plain_text:
Aging rate: How quickly or slowly your body
changes as you get older (such as developing
wrinkles or gray hair). While some people seem to
age more slowly, others seem to age more quickly.
Factors like exercise, diet, stress management, and
sleep habits can all influence your aging rate.
